title: POST /payments/process
$comment: userId is optional: a signed-in user pays as themselves, and a merchant's key must name one of its own users, which the handler checks (pci-remediation-plan.md F3). amount is in the currency's major unit (Stripe multiplies it by 100). Fields not listed are ignored, never queued (B1).

currency.$comment: The fiat currency charged, an ISO 4217 code

returnUrl.$comment: Where Stripe sends the payer back after 3DS
